Set the reference to a chain of <span class="pre">`Features`</span>. Replaces the previous <span class="pre">`member_element`</span>.

Returns a pair of (<span class="pre">`membership`</span>, <span class="pre">`member_element`</span>) where <span class="pre">`member_element`</span> is the <span class="pre">`Feature`</span> with owned <span class="pre">`FeatureChainings`</span> to the provided <span class="pre">`Features`</span> with order preserved.
